title: Bootstrapping the Finiteness of Leigh-Strassler Deformations and Uncovering Hidden Symmetries
summary: In this paper, we follow a Bootstrap-like approach to determine the most restricted form the finiteness constraint $\mathcal{F}(q,g,h,κ)$, which relates the four parameters of $\mathcal{N}=1$ Leigh-Strassler (LS) deformed models, by imposing mathematical and physical conditions. Focusing first on real parameters, we apply these conditions, together with a new symmetry of the superpotential we named ``q-symmetry'', to strongly constrains $\mathcal{F}$.
